summary: While the dark blue color applied to the section headings looks intentional, box 4 introduces a visual regression by changing the footer contact text from white to dark blue against a blue background, severely reducing legibility and contrast.

regressions.explanation: The contact text in the footer changed from white to dark blue (rgb(30, 64, 175)) on a bright blue background, resulting in very poor color contrast and inconsistent styling compared to the white text directly above it.
